## Pre-amble

### Run pre-amble script

```{r}

# Source metadata
here::i_am("15_validationDataPredictionModelling.qmd")
source(here::here("utilities", "R", "codeModules", "boilerPlate", "loadParamsLibrariesFunctions.R"))

```

### Read in plot list

```{r}

# Save as RDS
plotList <- readRDS(here::here(figDir, 
                    "14_validationDataDiffAbundance_figs.rds"))
 
```

## Load data

### Metadata

```{r}

# Source discovery study metadata
source(here::here("utilities", "R", "codeModules", "data", "readMetadata.R"))

# Read in pivot table
## Read in protein abundance table of actual samples
metaCrossSectional_validData <- read.table(here::here(validDir, "DIAProteomics", "directDIA_spectronautProcessed", "filtered",
                                                     "preSchool_validationData_tallFormatClean_samplesFiltered_byMissingness.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE) 
rownames(metaCrossSectional_validData) <- metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID

# Keep just child cross-sectional
metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Age_Group == "Child",]
table(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition)

# Exclude JIA
metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition != "JIA",]
table(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition)

# Keep just child cross-sectional
metaCrossSectional_child <- metaCrossSectional[metaCrossSectional$Age_Group == "Child",]
table(metaCrossSectional_child$Condition)

# Remove condition
metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[!metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition %in% dropConditions4Valid,]

# remove site
metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[!metaCrossSectional_validData$Site %in% dropSites4Valid,]

# Read in the training set of metadata
trainMetaData <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", 
                            paste0("trainData_justChildSamples_splitProp",trainSplitProp,"_allSites.tsv")),
                            sep="\t",
                            header=TRUE)

```

### Flip co-diagnosis

One sample diagnosed as CNO that is predicted as Crohn had a co-morbidity of IBD. So here we re-diagnose as Crohn and repeat.

```{r}

# If flipping CNO --> Crohn diagnosis
if (handleCrohnCoDiagnosis == "flip") {
  
  # Flip sample condition label 
  metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID == "PS_DR_095",]["Condition"] <- "Crohn"
  # metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID == "PS_DR_111",]["Condition"] <- "Crohn"
  
# If removing this sample
} else if (handleCrohnCoDiagnosis == "remove") {
  
  # Remove sample 
  metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID != "PS_DR_095",]
  # metaCrossSectional_validData <- metaCrossSectional_validData[metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID != "PS_DR_111",]
  
}

```

### Read in abundance data

```{r}

# Read in normalised data
qntTableNorm <- read.table(here::here(validDir, "DIAProteomics", "directDIA_spectronautProcessed", "normalised",
                                      "validationData_quantTable_normalisedCyclicLoess_noQCSamples.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
rownames(qntTableNorm) <- qntTableNorm$ProteinGroup
qntTableNorm <- qntTableNorm[,-1]

# Read discovery imputed data
quantTable_discovery <- read.table(here::here(diaDir, "normalised", paste0("crossSectional_quantTable_normalisedCyclicLoess.tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)

# If no imputation
if (imputMethod == "None") {
  
  # Read in unimputed
  impMat <- read.table(here::here(validDir, "DIAProteomics", "directDIA_spectronautProcessed", "normalised", 
                                  paste0("validationData_quantTable_normalisedCyclicLoess_noQCSamples.tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
  
  # Read in disvover
  impMatDiscovery <- read.table(here::here(diaDir, "normalised", paste0("crossSectional_quantTable_normalisedCyclicLoess.tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
  
  # Drop missing rows
  impMat <- impMat[!is.na(rowMeans(impMat)),]
  impMat <- t(impMat)
  impMatDiscovery <- impMatDiscovery[!is.na(rowMeans(impMatDiscovery)),]
  
  # Read in unfiltered
  impMatDiscovery_nonFilt <- quantTable_discovery[!is.na(rowSums(qntTableNorm)),]
  impMatDiscovery_nonFilt <- impMatDiscovery_nonFilt[,trainMetaData$Sample_ID]

# Else 
} else {
  
  # Read in imputed data
  impMat <- read.table(here::here(validDir, "DIAProteomics", "directDIA_spectronautProcessed", "imputation", 
                                  paste0("quantTable_validationData_imputedWith",imputMethod,".tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
  impMat <- t(impMat[,-1])
  impMatDiscovery <- read.table(here::here(impDir, paste0("quantTable_imputedWith",imputMethod,".tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
  
  # Read in unfiltered
  impMatDiscovery_nonFilt <- read.table(here::here(impDir, paste0("quantTable_imputedWith",imputMethod,".tsv")), sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
  
}

# Get common samples
metaCrossSectional_child <- metaCrossSectional_child[intersect(rownames(metaCrossSectional_child), colnames(quantTable_discovery)),]

```

### Split test/train discovery data

```{r}

# Get test metadata
testMetaData <- metaCrossSectional_child[!metaCrossSectional_child$Sample_ID %in% trainMetaData$Sample_ID,]
commonIDs <- intersect(testMetaData$Sample_ID, colnames(impMatDiscovery))
testMetaData <- testMetaData[commonIDs,]

# Split quant table
impMatTest <- impMatDiscovery[,commonIDs]
impMatDiscovery_nonFilt <- impMatDiscovery_nonFilt[,trainMetaData$Sample_ID]

```

### Read in desired proteins

```{r}

# Read in chosen proteins
finalTargets <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, "trainSplitProp0.8", "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel",
                                      "finalTargetProteins.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
rownames(finalTargets) <- finalTargets$Protein

# Add if in validation data
finalTargets["InValidation"] <- "No"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% colnames(impMat)),]["InValidation"] <- "Yes"

# Add if imputed in validation
finalTargets["ImputedInValidation"] <- NA
finalTargets[finalTargets$InValidation == "Yes",]["ImputedInValidation"] <- "Yes"
finalTargets[which(finalTargets$Protein %in% rownames(qntTableNorm[!is.na(rowSums(qntTableNorm)),])),]["ImputedInValidation"] <- "No"

```

### Create matrices for decoys

```{r}

# Subset
impMat_forDecoys <- impMat[,!colnames(impMat) %in% finalTargets$Protein]
impMatDiscovery_forDecoys <- impMatDiscovery[!rownames(impMatDiscovery) %in% finalTargets$Protein,]

```

### Get date-filtered and non site-associated proteins

```{r}

# Get proteins filtered by date
dateFiltProts <- finalTargets[finalTargets$inDateAdjustedSet == "Yes",]$Protein
dateFiltProts

# Remove site-filtered
noSiteProts <- finalTargets[finalTargets$inSiteAsPredictorSet == "No",]$Protein
noSiteProts

```

### Get sig in validation

```{r}

# Read in Differential abundance data
validDiffData <- read.table(here::here(resDir, "crossSectional", "validation","differentialAbundance",
                            "limmaResults_ANOVA_wrtCNOvContrasts_validationData.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
discoSiteDiffData <- read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "differentialAbundance",
                                "limmaResults_ANOVAwrtSite_crossSectionalData.tsv"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)

# Get consistently sig proteins
sigProts <- validDiffData[validDiffData$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]$Protein
siteDiscoSigProts <- discoSiteDiffData[discoSiteDiffData$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]$PG_ID

# Check common proteins (sig)
commonProtsSig <- intersect(finalTargets$Protein, 
                            sigProts)
finalTargets[commonProtsSig,]

# Check common proteins 
commonProts <- intersect(finalTargets$Protein, 
                         colnames(impMat))
finalTargets[commonProts,]

```

```{r}

# get protein sets
commonProtsCNO <- intersect(commonProts,
                            finalTargets[finalTargets$Model == "Both" | finalTargets$Model == "BiModal",]$Protein)
commonProtsGrp <- intersect(commonProts,
                            finalTargets[finalTargets$Model == "Both" | finalTargets$Model == "MultiGroup",]$Protein)

```

### Define output

```{r}

# Define outputs
validDir <- here::here(resValidPredDir,
                       ifelse(dateFilterProts & siteFiltProts,
                              "sigDateExclSite",
                              ifelse(dateFilterProts & sigFilterProts,
                                     "dateSigFilt",
                                     ifelse(siteFiltProts & sigFilterProts,
                                            "sigSiteFilt",
                                            ifelse(dateFilterProts,
                                                   "dateFilt",
                                                   "nonProtFilt")))),
                       ifelse(useDiscoveryTunedParams,
                              "bestTuned",
                              "unTuned"),
                       ifelse(is.null(covs2Select4Valid),
                              "forceNoCovSel",
                              paste0("forceCovSel_",paste(gsub("Z_","",covs2Select4Valid), collapse=""))),
                       ifelse(is.null(dropSites4Valid),
                              "allSites",
                              paste0("drop_",dropSites4Valid)),
                       ifelse(handleCrohnCoDiagnosis == "flip", # Whether to re-diagnose CNO sample as Crohn
                              "flipDiag",
                              ifelse(handleCrohnCoDiagnosis == "remove",
                              "dropDiag",
                              "keepDiag")),
                       paste0(ifelse(is.null(dropConditions4Valid),
                              "allGroups",
                              paste0("drop_",paste(gsub("myelitis", "", dropConditions4Valid), collapse=""))), "_", imputMethod))

# Create output
dir.create(here::here(validDir),
           recursive=TRUE)

# Create further directories
dir.create(here::here(validDir, "protAbundance"),
           recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(here::here(validDir, "metrics"),
           recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort"),
           recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(here::here(validDir, "pca", "discoveryCohort"),
           recursive=TRUE)

# Save
saveRDS(validDir,
        here::here("params", paste0("validationAnalysis_outputDirectory_",imputMethod,".rds")))

```

### Filter

```{r}

# If filter by date
if (dateFilterProts) {
  
  # Filter by date
  commonProtsCNO <- commonProtsCNO[commonProtsCNO %in% dateFiltProts]
  commonProtsGrp <- commonProtsGrp[commonProtsGrp %in% dateFiltProts]
  
}

# If filter by sig 
if (sigFilterProts) {
  
  # Filter by sig in validation diff abundance
  commonProtsCNO <- commonProtsCNO[commonProtsCNO %in% sigProts]
  commonProtsGrp <- commonProtsGrp[commonProtsGrp %in% sigProts]
  
}

# If filter by non site-associated 
if (siteFiltProts) {
  
  # Filter by sig in validation diff abundance
  commonProtsCNO <- commonProtsCNO[commonProtsCNO %in% noSiteProts]
  commonProtsGrp <- commonProtsGrp[commonProtsGrp %in% noSiteProts]
  
}

# Get all proteins together
allCommonProts <- union(commonProtsCNO,
                        commonProtsGrp)

```

### Predict condition from abundance

#### Process data

```{r}

# Fix infectious osteo
metaCrossSectional_validData["Condition"] <- gsub("Infectious ", "Inf", metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition)
metaCrossSectional_validData["CondSite"] <- gsub("Infectious ", "Inf", metaCrossSectional_validData$CondSite)

# Get relevant data
testData <- merge(metaCrossSectional_validData, 
                  impMat,
                  by.x="Sample_ID", by.y="row.names")

# Drop NAs
testData <- testData[apply(testData[,c("Age","Sex","PLATE",colnames(impMat))], 1, function(smplRow) all(!is.na(smplRow)) & all(smplRow != 0)),]

# Scale
for (i in seq_along(colnames(impMat))) { testData[paste0("Z_",colnames(impMat)[[i]])] <- scale(testData[colnames(impMat)[[i]]], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE) }
testData["Age"] <- scale(testData$Age, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

```

#### BiModal

```{r}

# Make condition a binary
testData["BiModal"] <- ifelse(testData$Condition == "CNO", "CNO", "Other")
testData$BiModal <- as.factor(testData$BiModal)

```

#### Compare discovery to validation protein abundnance

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5}

# Scale data
quantTable_discoveryScaled <- cbind(PG.ProteinAccessions=rownames(quantTable_discovery),
                                    data.frame(t(apply(quantTable_discovery, 1, FUN=scale, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, simplify=TRUE))))
colnames(quantTable_discoveryScaled)[-1] <- colnames(quantTable_discovery)
quantTable_validDataScaled <- cbind(PG.ProteinAccessions=rownames(qntTableNorm),
                                    data.frame(t(apply(qntTableNorm, 1, FUN=scale, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, simplify=TRUE))))
colnames(quantTable_validDataScaled)[-1] <- colnames(qntTableNorm)

# Make tall format
discoveryTallData <- reshape2::melt(quantTable_discoveryScaled)
validTallData <- reshape2::melt(quantTable_validDataScaled)

# Add metadata
discoveryTallData <- merge(discoveryTallData, metaCrossSectional[metaCrossSectional$Condition != "JIA",], by.x="variable", by.y="Sample_ID")
validTallData <- merge(validTallData, metaCrossSectional_validData, by.x="variable", by.y="Sample_ID")
discoveryTallData$variable <- as.character(discoveryTallData$variable)
validTallData$variable <- as.character(validTallData$variable)

# Combine
commonCols <- intersect(colnames(discoveryTallData),
                        colnames(validTallData))
tallData <- rbind(discoveryTallData[,commonCols], validTallData[,commonCols])
tallData$Data_Group <- gsub("TrainTest","Discovery",tallData$Data_Group)

```

##### Plot CNO proteins

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}

# Filter to CNO proteins
filtByProts <- intersect(commonProtsCNO, rownames(quantTable_discoveryScaled))
filtByProts <- intersect(filtByProts, rownames(quantTable_validDataScaled))

# Subset to desired proteins
toPlot <- tallData[which(tallData$PG.ProteinAccessions %in% filtByProts),]

# Add Protein names etc
toPlot <- merge(finalTargets, 
                toPlot,
                by.x="Protein",
                by.y="PG.ProteinAccessions")

# Adjust colours
condStudyCols <- condCols
names(condStudyCols) <- paste0("Discovery.", names(condStudyCols))
lightCols <- lighten(condCols, 0.5)
names(lightCols) <- paste0("Validation.", names(lightCols))
condStudyCols <- c(condStudyCols, lightCols)

# Add significance
toPlot["Protein"] <- paste0(toPlot$SYMBOL)

# Plot
p1 <- ggplot(toPlot,
             aes(x=Condition, 
                 y=value)) + 
  geom_boxplot(mapping=aes(fill=interaction(Data_Group, 
                                            Condition)),
               outlier.shape=NA) +
  geom_point(mapping=aes(fill=interaction(Data_Group, 
                                          Condition)), 
             position=position_jitterdodge(),
             show.legend=FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ gsub("p = .*","",Protein), nrow=1, scale="free_y") +
  xlab("") + ylab("Log2 Abundance") + 
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1, byRow=TRUE)) +
  ggtitle("Comparison of candidate protein abundance between discovery and validation datasets") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=condStudyCols) +
  theme_classic(base_size=16) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5),
        strip.text=element_text(size=10),
        legend.position="top",
        legend.title=element_blank()) +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2))
print(p1)

```

#### Random forest

```{r}

# If not tuning on validation data
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {

    # Read in optimal by AUC
    bestModel_biModal <- list(OptimalParams=read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", 
                                                       "lassoRes_biModal_optimalTunedModel_byAUC.tsv"),
                                                       sep="\t",
                                                       header=TRUE))
    bestModel_multiGroup <- list(OptimalParams=read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", 
                                                          "lassoRes_multiGroup_optimalTunedModel_byAUC.tsv"),
                                                          sep="\t",
                                                          header=TRUE))
    bestModel_biModal_grpProts <- list(OptimalParams=read.table(here::here(resCrossDiscoDir, paste0("trainSplitProp",trainSplitProp), "sampleRandom", "biomarkers", "finalModel", 
                                                                "lassoRes_biModalMultiGroupProts_optimalTunedModel_byAUC.tsv"),
                                                                sep="\t",
                                                                header=TRUE))

}
```

### Calculate multi-class performance

```{r}

# Change predicted to character
misMatch_bim$Predicted <- as.character(misMatch_bim$Predicted)
misMatch_grp$Predicted <- as.character(misMatch_grp$Predicted)
misMatch_bim_grpProts$Predicted <- as.character(misMatch_bim_grpProts$Predicted)

# Ensure all levels, even if none correctly classified for one group
misMatch_grp$Predicted <- factor(misMatch_grp$Predicted, 
                                 levels=unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition))
misMatch_grp$Actual <- factor(misMatch_grp$Actual, 
                              levels=unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition))

# Get confusion matrix and calculate metrics
metricsBim <- caret::confusionMatrix(factor(misMatch_bim$Predicted, levels=c("CNO", "Other")),
                                     factor(misMatch_bim$Actual, levels=c("CNO", "Other")))
metricsGrp <- caret::confusionMatrix(table(misMatch_grp[,c("Predicted", "Actual")]))
metricsBim_grpProts <- caret::confusionMatrix(factor(misMatch_bim_grpProts$Predicted, levels=c("CNO", "Other")),
                                              factor(misMatch_bim_grpProts$Actual, levels=c("CNO", "Other")))

# Calculate AUC/ROC

# If list returned
if (is.null(nrow(metricsBim$byClass))) { metricsBim$byClass <- t(as.matrix(metricsBim$byClass)); rownames(metricsBim$byClass) <- "CNO" } # Assume CNO
if (is.null(nrow(metricsGrp$byClass))) { metricsGrp$byClass <- t(as.matrix(metricsGrp$byClass)); rownames(metricsGrp$byClass) <- "CNO" } # Assume CNO
if (is.null(nrow(metricsBim_grpProts$byClass))) { metricsBim_grpProts$byClass <- t(as.matrix(metricsBim_grpProts$byClass)); rownames(metricsBim_grpProts$byClass) <- "CNO" } # Assume CNO
 
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}

# Get metrics, make tall and clean
metricsDataBim <- data.frame(Group=rownames(metricsBim$byClass),
                             metricsBim$byClass)

                             metricsGrp$byClass)
metricsDataBim_grpProts <- data.frame(Group=rownames(metricsBim_grpProts$byClass),
                                  metricsBim_grpProts$byClass)
metricsDataBim <- cleanVars(metricsDataBim)
metricsDataGrp <- cleanVars(metricsDataGrp)
metricsDataBim_grpProts <- cleanVars(metricsDataBim_grpProts)

# Calculate MCC
metricsDataBim["AUROC"] <- calcOneVsAllAUROC(misMatch_bim, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$BiModal))[metricsDataBim$Group]
metricsDataGrp["AUROC"] <- calcOneVsAllAUROC(misMatch_grp, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition))[metricsDataGrp$Group]
metricsDataBim_grpProts["AUROC"] <- calcOneVsAllAUROC(misMatch_bim_grpProts, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$BiModal))[metricsDataBim_grpProts$Group]
metricsDataBim["MCC"] <- calcOneVsAllMCC(misMatch_bim, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$BiModal))[metricsDataBim$Group]
metricsDataGrp["MCC"] <- calcOneVsAllMCC(misMatch_grp, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$Condition))[metricsDataGrp$Group]
metricsDataBim_grpProts["MCC"] <- calcOneVsAllMCC(misMatch_bim_grpProts, unique(metaCrossSectional_validData$BiModal))[metricsDataBim_grpProts$Group]

# Make tall
metricsDataGrpTall <- reshape2::melt(metricsDataGrp,
                                     id.vars="Group")

# Plot

           y=value,
           fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",
           position="dodge") +

             color="darkgrey") +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(variable),

  scale_fill_manual(values=condCols) +
  ylim(-0.25, 1.2) +
  theme_classic(base_size=32) +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),
        legend.text=element_text(size=32),
        legend.position="top",
        legend.direction="horizontal")

# Save
ggsave(here::here(validDir, "metrics",
                  paste0("modelMetric_conditionWiseGroupScores.png")),
                  plt, width=8000, height=3500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)

 # Add to list
newList <- list(plt)
names(newList) <- c(paste0("modelMetrics_validData_", imputMethod))
plotList <- append(plotList,
                   newList)

# Plot
plt <- ggplot(metricsDataGrpTall[metricsDataGrpTall$variable == "MCC",],
       aes(x=variable,
           y=value,
           fill=Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",
```

```{r, fig.width=24, fig.height=8}
# Loop over sets

                             metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID, drop=FALSE]), center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

  # Merge with metadata
  selectProtPCA_metaData <- merge(matchSets[[i]], selectProtPCA$x, by.x="ID", by.y="row.names")
  
  # Make character
  selectProtPCA_metaData$Predicted <- as.character(selectProtPCA_metaData$Predicted)
  
  # Get contributions
  contribs <- data.frame(Protein=rownames(selectProtPCA$rotation), 
                         selectProtPCA$rotation*3)  
  
  # Loop over pcs
  for (j in seq(1, 3)) {
    
    # Only show mis-classified CNO patients
    checkMismatch <- sum(selectProtPCA_metaData$Condition != "CNO" & selectProtPCA_metaData$Mismatch == "Yes")
    if (checkMismatch > 0) { selectProtPCA_metaData[selectProtPCA_metaData$Condition != "CNO" & selectProtPCA_metaData$Mismatch == "Yes",]["Mismatch"] <- "No" }
  
    # Plot PCA

          geom_text_repel(data=selectProtPCA_metaData,

                          size=12,
                          max.overlaps=10) +
          scale_fill_manual(values=tidyCondCols) +

                                       label = Protein),
                     color="black",

          geom_label_repel(data=contribs,

                                       y = .data[[paste0("PC", j+1)]]*ifelse(names(matchSets)[[i]] == "BiModal", 1.55, 5),

           p1, width=6000, height=6000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort",
                      paste0("pcaPlot_pc",j,"-",j+1,"_",names(matchSets)[[i]],"Proteins_withLoadings.png")), 
           p2, width=6000, height=6000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort",
                      paste0("pcaPlot_pc",j,"-",j+1,"_",names(matchSets)[[i]],"Proteins.png")), 
           p3, width=6000, height=6000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
  
  }
```

```{r}


# Get age colours
ageCols <- colorRamp2(c(base::max(matchSets[[i]]$Age), 
                        base::min(matchSets[[i]]$Age)), 
                      c("white", "darkred"))

# Loop over sets of matches
for (i in seq_along(matchSets)) {
  
  # Add sex
  matchSets[[i]]$Sex <- as.character(matchSets[[i]]$Sex)

  # Scale data
  m <- t(apply(quantTable_validDataScaled[prots[[i]], matchSets[[i]]$ID],
               1, function(row) scale(row, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)))
  
  # Check mismatches
  misMatches <- ifelse(matchSets[[i]]$Mismatch == "Yes", 4, NA) #  & matchSets[[i]]$Predicted != "Other"
  
  # Get 
  rownames(m) <- finalTargets[rownames(m),]$SYMBOL
  
  # Plot
  hmap <- Heatmap(m,
                  
                  # Colour function
                  col = colorRamp2(c(base::max(m, na.rm=TRUE), 0, base::min(m, na.rm=TRUE)),
                                   c("red", "white", "blue")),
                  
                  # Cluster
                  cluster_columns = TRUE,
                  cluster_rows = TRUE,
                  
                  # Annotate with Ped CNO score
                  top_annotation = columnAnnotation(` `=anno_simple(matchSets[[i]]$Sex, 
                                                                    col=c("M"="mediumpurple", "F"="limegreen")),
                                                    # `  `=anno_simple(matchSets[[i]]$Ethnicity, 
                                                    #                  col=c("C"="salmon", "African American"="mediumblue")),
                                                    `   `=anno_simple(matchSets[[i]]$Age, 
                                                                      col=ageCols),
                                                    `    `=anno_simple(matchSets[[i]]$Site, 
                                                                       col=siteCols),
                                                    `     `=anno_simple(as.character(matchSets[[i]]$Condition), 
                                                                        col=c(condCols, "Other"="#0061FF")),
                                                    `      `=anno_simple(as.character(matchSets[[i]]$Predicted), 
                                                                         col=c(condCols, "Other"="#0061FF"),
                                                                         pch=misMatches)),
                  
                  # Legend
                  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                  
                  # NA Colour
                  na_col="grey"
  )

                 paste0(names(matchSets)[[i]], "_hmap_misMatch.png")), 
        width=600, height=150 + 15 * nrow(m), units="px")
```

```{r}
# Keep just common prots
commonTargets <- finalTargets[commonProtsCNO,]

                             metaCrossSectional_child$Sample_ID]

## Condition

                        meta=metaCrossSectional_child, varOfInterest="Condition", varOfInterest_2="CondSite", refLevel="", chosenCols=condSiteCols, nRow=ceiling(length(commonProtsCNO) / 8)) +
  theme(strip.text=element_text(size=32),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        legend.text=element_text(size=40)) +

  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        strip.background =element_rect(fill="grey"),
        legend.direction="horizontal") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2),

  theme(legend.position="bottom",
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=4.5}
# Get bimodal 
bimData <- quantTable_validDataScaled[which(rownames(quantTable_validDataScaled) %in% commonProtsCNO),
                        metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID]
bimData <- merge(t(bimData), metaCrossSectional_validData, by.x="row.names", by.y="Sample_ID")

# Get plot list
plts <- vector(mode="list",
              length=length(commonProtsCNO))

# Loop over proteins
for (i in seq_along(commonProtsCNO)) {

  # Plot
  plt <- ggplot(bimData,
                aes(x=Sex, 
                    y=.data[[commonProtsCNO[[i]]]],
                    fill=Condition,
                    shape=Sex)) + 
           stat_summary(fun = "median", 
                        fun.min = "median", 
                        fun.max = "median", 
                        size= 0.3, 
                        geom = "crossbar") +
           geom_point(size=4,
                      alpha=0.75) +  
           facet_grid(cols=vars(Condition)) +
           scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 23)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values=condCols) +
           theme_classic(base_size=24) + 
           theme(legend.position="none",
                 axis.title=element_text(size=28))

  # Add to plot
  plts[[i]] <- plt

}

# Plot
plt <- plot_grid(plotlist=plts,
                 nrow=ceiling(length(plts) / 5))

# save
dir.create(here::here(validDir, "protAbundance"))
ggsave(here::here(validDir, "protAbundance",
                  paste0("selectProteinAbundance_biModalModel_bySex_validData_stripPlot.png")),
                  plt, width=12000, height=(ceiling(length(plts) / 5) * 1250 ) + 750, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=6}

# If wanting to downsample
if (!is.null(nReps2DownSample)) {
  
  # Define mccVals
  mccVals_downSample <- c()
  specVals_downSample <- c()
  sensVals_downSample <- c()
  ppvVals_downSample <- c()
  npvVals_downSample <- c()
  
  # Create output
  dir.create(here::here(validDir, "downSample", "biModal"),
             recursive=TRUE,
             showWarnings=FALSE)
  
  # Down-sample
  biModal_downSample <- splitLOO(meta=metaCrossSectional_validData, 
                                     qntTable=impMatScaled[commonProtsCNO,
                                                           metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID], 
                                     covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                     classVar="BiModal",
                                     downSampleNReps=nReps2DownSample)
  
  # Loop over down-samples
  for (i in seq_along(biModal_downSample)) {

    # If tune parameters
    if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {

      # Apply feature selection
      lassoRes_multiBim <-  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModal_downSample[[i]],
                                                                                         functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                         metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                                                                         thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                         runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                         covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                         mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                     floor(sqrt(length(commonProtsCNO))),
                                                                                                     bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                         num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                         splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                         max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                                                         min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                                                                         importance = "permutation",
                                                                                         local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                         tuneParams = FALSE)))

    # Else use chosen/default parameters
    } else {

      # Apply feature selection
      lassoRes_multiBim <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModal_downSample[[i]],
                                                                                         functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                         thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                         runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                         covs2Select = covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                         importance = "permutation",
                                                                                         local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                         tuneParams = FALSE))

    }
    
    # Get mistmatches
    misMatch_bim <- getMisMatchedClasses(lassoRes=lassoRes_multiBim,
                                         dataSplits=biModal_downSample[[i]],
                                         metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData)
    misMatch_bim <- misMatch_bim[!is.na(misMatch_bim$Split),]
    
    # Plot by age/sex
    plt <- ggplot(misMatch_bim,
           aes(x=Mismatch,
               y=Age,
               fill=Predicted,
               shape=Sex)) + 
      facet_grid(cols=vars(Condition)) +
      stat_summary(data=misMatch_bim,
                   aes(x=Mismatch,
                       y=Age),
                   fun = "median", 
                   fun.min = "median", 
                   fun.max = "median", 
                   size= 0.3, 
                   geom = "crossbar",
                   inherit.aes=FALSE) +
      geom_point(size=6,
                 alpha=0.75,
                 position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.25,
                                               dodge.width=0.15)) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 23)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values=c(condCols,
                                 "Other"="#0061FF")) +
      labs(fill="Predicted") + 
      theme_classic(base_size=42) + 
      theme(axis.title=element_text(size=54),
            legend.position="top",
            legend.title.position="top") + 
      guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                               override.aes=list(shape=21)))
    
    # Save
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "downSample", "biModal",
                      paste0("misMatch_downSmplbiM_rep",i,"_stripPlot.png")), 
           plt, width=7000, height=3500, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)

    # Calculate model metrics
    modelMetrics <- confusionMatrix(factor(misMatch_bim$Predicted, levels=c("CNO", "Other")),
                                    factor(misMatch_bim$Actual, levels=c("CNO", "Other")))
    specVals_downSample <- c(specVals_downSample, modelMetrics$byClass[["Specificity"]])
    sensVals_downSample <- c(sensVals_downSample, modelMetrics$byClass[["Sensitivity"]])
    ppvVals_downSample <- c(ppvVals_downSample, modelMetrics$byClass[["Pos Pred Value"]])
    npvVals_downSample <- c(npvVals_downSample, modelMetrics$byClass[["Neg Pred Value"]])

    # Calculate MCC
    mccVal <- mltools::mcc(as.character(misMatch_bim$Predicted),
                           as.character(misMatch_bim$Actual))
    mccVals_downSample <- c(mccVals_downSample, 
                            mccVal)
    
    # Report
    print(paste0("// Iter ", i, " MCC value = ", round(mccVal, 3)))

  }
  
  # Plot
  plt <- ggplot(data.frame(Score=c(mccVals_downSample,
                                    specVals_downSample,
                                    sensVals_downSample,
                                    ppvVals_downSample,
                                    npvVals_downSample),
                           Metric=c(rep("MCC", nReps2DownSample),
                                    rep("Specificity", nReps2DownSample),
                                    rep("Sensitivity", nReps2DownSample),
                                    rep("PPV", nReps2DownSample),
                                    rep("NPV", nReps2DownSample))),
         aes(x=Metric,
             y=Score)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,
               
               color="darkgrey") +
    facet_wrap(~ Metric,
               ncol=5,
               scale="free_x") +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter(size=1.5,
                alpha=0.65,
                color="darkblue") +
    geom_point(data.frame(Value=c(mccVals["BiModal"],
                                  metricsBim$byClass["Specificity"],
                                  metricsBim$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                                  metricsBim$byClass["Pos Pred Value"],
                                  metricsBim$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]),
                          Metric=c("MCC", 
                                   "Specificity",
                                   "Sensitivity",
                                   "PPV",
                                   "NPV")),
               mapping=aes(y=Value,
                           x=Metric),
               color="darkred",
               shape="*",
               size=20,
               linetype="dashed") +
    ylim(-0.5,1) +
    theme_classic(base_size=28) +
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=48),
          axis.text.x=element_blank())
  
    # Save
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "downSample", "biModal",
                      paste0("metrics_biModal_downSampledRep.png")), 
           plt, width=4500, height=3000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
  
  # Plot
  plt <- ggplot(data.frame(Score=c(mccVals_downSample),
                           Metric=c(rep("MCC", nReps2DownSample))),
         aes(x=Metric,
             y=Score)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,
               
               color="darkgrey") +
    facet_wrap(~ Metric,
               ncol=5,
               scale="free_x") +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter(size=1.5,
                alpha=0.65,
                color="darkblue") +
    geom_point(data.frame(Value=c(mccVals["BiModal"]),
                          Metric=c("MCC")),
               mapping=aes(y=Value,
                           x=Metric),
               color="darkred",
               shape="*",
               size=20,
               linetype="dashed") +
    ylim(-0.5,1) +
    ylab("MCC") +
    xlab("") +
    theme_classic(base_size=28) +
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=48),
          axis.text.x=element_blank())
  
    # Save
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "downSample", "biModal",
                      paste0("mcc_biModal_downSampledRep.png")), 
           plt, width=1500, height=3000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
  
}
```

### Randomisation

#### Shuffle sample labels

```{r}

rm(lassoRes_biModal)
rm(lassoRes_multiBimGrpProts)
rm(lassoRes_multiBim)
rm(lassoRes_multiGrp)
rm(lassoRes_biModal_grpProts)
gc()

# If not tuning on validation data
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {

  # Generate shuffles of data
  shuffSplits_bim <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=biModalSplits, 
                                      metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                      selectProts=commonProtsCNO,
                                      responseVar="BiModal",
                                      nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                      mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                  floor(sqrt(length(commonProtsCNO))),
                                                  bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                      num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                      splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                      max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                      min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                      covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  shuffSplits_grp <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=groupSplits, 
                                      metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                      selectProts=commonProtsGrp,
                                      responseVar="Condition",
                                      nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                      mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                      num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                      splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                      max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                      min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                      covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  shuffSplits_bimGrpProts <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=biModalSplits_grpProts, 
                                              metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                              selectProts=allCommonProts,
                                              responseVar="BiModal",
                                              nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                              mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                          floor(sqrt(length(allCommonProts))),
                                                          bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                              num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                              splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                              max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                              min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                              covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  
} else {
  
  # Generate shuffles of data
  shuffSplits_bim <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=biModalSplits, 
                                      metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                      selectProts=commonProtsCNO,
                                      responseVar="BiModal",
                                      nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                      covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  shuffSplits_grp <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=groupSplits, 
                                      metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                      selectProts=commonProtsGrp,
                                      responseVar="Condition",
                                      nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                      covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  shuffSplits_bimGrpProts <- shuffleValidData(dataSplits=biModalSplits_grpProts, 
                                              metaData=metaCrossSectional_validData,
                                              selectProts=allCommonProts,
                                              responseVar="BiModal",
                                              nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                              covs2Include=covs2Select4Valid)
  gc()
  
}
```

```{r}
# Run PCA
selectProtPCA <- prcomp(t(impMat[which(rownames(impMat) %in% commonProtsCNO),
                           metaCrossSectional_validData$Sample_ID, drop=FALSE]), center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

# Merge with metadata
selectProtPCA_metaData <- merge(metaCrossSectional_validData[,!grepl("^PC",colnames(metaCrossSectional_validData))], 
                                selectProtPCA$x, by.x="Sample_ID", by.y="row.names")
  
# Loop over PCs
## All together
maxPCs <- ifelse((length(commonProts)-1) >= 3, 3, (length(commonProts)-1))
for (i in seq_len(maxPCs)) {
  
    # Get contributions
    contribs <- data.frame(Protein=rownames(selectProtPCA$rotation), 
                           selectProtPCA$rotation*3)
    
    # Plot
    # Technical
    plate_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPCA_metaData, var=get_eigenvalue(selectProtPCA), color_by="PLATE", label_id="Sample_ID", shape_by="Sex", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=11) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 24)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=plateCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=64),
            legend.title=element_text(size=52),
            legend.text=element_text(size=42),
            axis.title=element_text(size=80),
            plot.title=element_text(size=96)) +
      labs(fill="Plate") +
      ggtitle("Validation Samples") +
      guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    site_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPCA_metaData, var=get_eigenvalue(selectProtPCA), color_by="Site", label_id="Sample_ID", shape_by="Sex", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=11) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 24)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=siteCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=64),
            legend.title=element_text(size=52),
            legend.text=element_text(size=42),
            axis.title=element_text(size=80),
            plot.title=element_text(size=96)) +
      labs(fill="Site") +
      ggtitle("Validation Samples") +
      guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    
    ## Biological
    cond_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPCA_metaData, var=get_eigenvalue(selectProtPCA), 
                              shape_by="Sex", color_by="Condition", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=11) + 
      geom_textsegment(data=contribs,
                       mapping=aes(xend = .data[[paste0("PC",i)]], yend = .data[[paste0("PC",i+1)]], x=0, y=0, label = Protein),
                       arrow = arrow(), linewidth=1.5, size=10) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 22, 25)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=tidyCondCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=92),
            legend.title=element_text(size=88),
            legend.text=element_text(size=64),
            axis.title=element_text(size=104),
            plot.title=element_text(size=116)) +
      labs(shape="Sex") +
      ggtitle("Validation Samples") +
      guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    condSite_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPCA_metaData, var=get_eigenvalue(selectProtPCA), 
                              shape_by="Site", color_by="Condition", label_id="Sample_ID", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=11) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 22, 25)) + 
      scale_fill_manual(values=tidyCondCols) +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=92),
            legend.title=element_text(size=88),
            legend.text=element_text(size=64),
            axis.title=element_text(size=104),
            plot.title=element_text(size=116)) +
      labs(shape="Site") +
      ggtitle("Validation Samples") +
      guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,override.aes=list(shape=21), title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    age_plt <- Plot2DPCA(meta=selectProtPCA_metaData, var=get_eigenvalue(selectProtPCA), color_by="Age", label_id="Sample_ID", shape_by="Sex", pcs=c(i, i+1), pch_size=11) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(21, 24)) + 
      scale_fill_continuous(high="darkred", low="white") +
      theme_classic(base_size=36) +
      theme(legend.position="right", 
            legend.direction="vertical",
            axis.text=element_text(size=80),
            legend.title=element_text(size=72),
            legend.text=element_text(size=56),
            axis.title=element_text(size=92),
            plot.title=element_text(size=112)) +
      ggtitle("Validation Samples") +
      guides(fill=guide_colourbar(barheight=10, title.position="top"), shape=guide_legend(ncol=1,title.position="top"))
    
    # Create output
    dir.create(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort", "biModal"),
               recursive=TRUE)
    
    # Save
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort", "biModal",
                      paste0("PC",i,"to",i+1,"_colByPlate_validCohort_biModalProts.png")), 
           plate_plt, width=10000, height=8000, units="px",limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(here::here(validDir, "pca", "validationCohort", "biModal",
                      paste0("PC",i,"to",i+1,"_colBySite_validCohort_biModalProts.png")),
```

### Predict model to discovery data

#### Scale imputation matrix

```{r}

# Scale imputed matrix
impMatScaled <- data.frame(t(apply(impMatDiscovery[,metaCrossSectional_child$Sample_ID], 1, FUN=scale, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE, simplify=TRUE)))
colnames(impMatScaled) <- metaCrossSectional_child$Sample_ID

```

#### Create 10-fold data splits

This matches how data were split in discovery cohort.

```{r}

# Make sex a number
trainMetaData$Sex <- as.factor(trainMetaData$Sex)

# Split data Validation
biModalSplits <- splitOverIters(meta=trainMetaData, 
                                qntTable=impMatScaled[commonProtsCNO,
                                                      trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                                classVar="BiModal",
                                splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                                nIters=nIters, 
                                method="Random", 
                                considerGroup=FALSE)
groupSplits <- splitOverIters(meta=trainMetaData, 
                              qntTable=impMatScaled[commonProtsGrp,
                                                    trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                              classVar="Condition",
                              splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                              nIters=nIters, 
                              method="Random", 
                              considerGroup=FALSE)

### Predict CNO with group proteins
biModalSplits_grpProts <- splitOverIters(meta=trainMetaData, 
                                   qntTable=impMatScaled[allCommonProts,
                                                         trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 
                                   classVar="BiModal",
                                   splitProp=trainSplitProp, 
                                   nIters=nIters, 
                                   method="Random", 
                                   considerGroup=FALSE)

# Add covariates
trainMetaData["Z_Age"] <- scale(trainMetaData$Age, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
if (!is.null(covs2Select4Valid)) {
  
  # Add covaraites to various splits
  biModalSplits <- addCovs_toSplitData(splitList=biModalSplits,
                                       meta=trainMetaData,
                                       covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid)
  groupSplits <- addCovs_toSplitData(splitList=groupSplits,
                                     meta=trainMetaData,
                                     covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid)
  biModalSplits_grpProts <- addCovs_toSplitData(splitList=biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                meta=trainMetaData,
                                                covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid)
  
}

```

#### Fit models

```{r}

# If not tuning on validation data
if (useDiscoveryTunedParams) {
    
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    tuneParams=FALSE,
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                floor(sqrt(length(commonProtsCNO))),
                                                                                                bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                    num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                    splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                    min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                                                                    max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     tuneParams=FALSE,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                                                                     num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                     splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                     max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth))
  
  ### Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                            functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                            metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                            thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                            covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                            runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                            tuneParams=FALSE,
                                                                                            importance = "permutation",
                                                                                            local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                            mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                                                        floor(sqrt(length(allCommonProts))),
                                                                                                        bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                                                            min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                                                                            num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                                                            splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                                                            max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth))
  
} else {
    
  # Apply feature selection
  ## Without covariates
  lassoRes_biModal  <- suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits,
                                                                                    functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                    metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                    thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                    covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                    importance = "permutation",
                                                                                    local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                    runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                    tuneParams=FALSE))
  lassoRes_multiGrp <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = groupSplits,
                                                                                     functionSelection = multimodalLasso,
                                                                                     metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                     thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                     covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                     importance = "permutation",
                                                                                     local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                     runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                     tuneParams=FALSE))
  
  ### Predict CNO with group proteins
  lassoRes_biModal_grpProts <-  suppressWarnings(applyMultiVarSelectionForCrossVal_withModel(inputListwSplits = biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                                                                            functionSelection = TwoClassLasso,
                                                                                            metaData = trainMetaData,
                                                                                            thresMod = 0, # Don't filter any proteins
                                                                                            covs2Select=covs2Select4Valid,
                                                                                            importance = "permutation",
                                                                                            local.importance = TRUE,
                                                                                            runLASSOSelection = FALSE,
                                                                                            tuneParams=FALSE))
  
}

```
#### Get performances

```{r}

# Calculate metrics
bimMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal,
                                  splitData=biModalSplits,
                                  metaData=trainMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=FALSE,
                                  predCol="BiModal")
grpMetrics <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_multiGrp,
                                  splitData=groupSplits,
                                  metaData=trainMetaData,
                                  multiGroup=TRUE,
                                  predCol="Condition")
bimMetrics_grpProts <- calcOneVsAllMetrics(model=lassoRes_biModal_grpProts,
                                           splitData=biModalSplits_grpProts,
                                           metaData=trainMetaData,
                                           multiGroup=FALSE,
                                           predCol="BiModal")
bimMetrics["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics))
grpMetrics["Split"] <- rep(seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics)),
                           length(unique(grpMetrics$Group)))
bimMetrics_grpProts["Split"] <- seq_len(nrow(bimMetrics_grpProts))

# Make tall
bimMetricsTall <- melt(bimMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
grpMetricsTall <- melt(grpMetrics,
                       id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))
bimMetrics_grpProtsTall <- melt(bimMetrics_grpProts,
                                id.vars=c("Group", "Split"))

# Drop NPV/PPV
bimMetricsTall <- bimMetricsTall[!bimMetricsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]
grpMetricsTall <- grpMetricsTall[!grpMetricsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]
bimMetrics_grpProtsTall <- bimMetrics_grpProtsTall[!bimMetrics_grpProtsTall$variable %in% c("NPV", "PPV"),]
```

##### Plot

```{r}

plotModelMetrics <- function(plotData,
                             cols) {

  # Get plots
  plt <- ggplot(plotData,
         aes(x=Group,
             y=value,
             color=Group)) + 
    stat_summary(fun = "median", 
                 fun.min = "median", 
                 fun.max = "median", 
                 color = "black",
                 size= 0.8, 
                 geom = "crossbar",
                 inherit.aes=TRUE,
                 show.legend=FALSE) + # position=position_jitterdodge()
    geom_jitter(size=6,
                height = 0,
                alpha=0.4,
                width=0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values=cols) +
    facet_grid(cols=vars(variable)) +
    ylab("Score") + 
    xlab("") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                       limits=c(-0.05, 1.05)) +
    theme_classic(base_size=16) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
  
  # Return
  return(plt)
  
}

# Get plots
p1 <- plotModelMetrics(plotData=bimMetricsTall,
                       cols=condCols) + 
  # geom_jitter(width=0.15) + 
  ggtitle("Bi-Modal") +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        plot.title=element_text(size=64),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=20),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36)) 
p2 <- plotModelMetrics(plotData=grpMetricsTall,
                       cols=condCols) + 
  # geom_jitter(width=0.1,
  #             show.legend=FALSE) + 
  ggtitle("Multi-Modal") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.direction="horizontal",
        plot.title=element_text(size=64),
        legend.text=element_text(size=48),
        legend.title=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=28),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36))   +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,
                           override.aes = list(size = 25)))
p3 <- plotModelMetrics(plotData=bimMetrics_grpProtsTall,
                       cols=condCols) + 
  # geom_jitter(width=0.15) + 
  ggtitle("Bi-Modal (Whole Panel)") +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        plot.title=element_text(size=64),
        axis.title=element_text(size=64),
        strip.text=element_text(size=20),
        axis.text=element_text(size=36))

# Save
ggsave(here::here(validDir, "metrics",
                  "biModal_allMetrics_validationProteinsOnDiscoveryData.png"),
       p1,
       limitsize=FALSE,
       width=4850, height=2000, units="px")
ggsave(here::here(validDir, "metrics",
                  "multiGroup_perGroupOneVsAll_allMetrics_validationProteinsOnDiscoveryData.png"),
       p2,
       limitsize=FALSE,
       width=5000, height=1750, units="px")
ggsave(here::here(validDir, "metrics",
                  "biModalMultiGrpProts_allMetrics_validationProteinsOnDiscoveryData.png"),
       p3,
       limitsize=FALSE,
       width=4850, height=2000, units="px")

# Add to list

names(newList) <- c(paste0("modelMetrics_discoveryWithOnlyValidProts_biModal_", imputMethod),
                    paste0("modelMetrics_discoveryWithOnlyValidProts_multiGroup_", imputMethod),
```

### Investigate CRP in misclassified patients

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

# Get false +ves and -ves
falsePos <- misMatchDisco_grp[misMatchDisco_grp$Actual != "CNO" & misMatchDisco_grp$Predicted == "CNO",]$ID
falseNeg <- misMatchDisco_grp[misMatchDisco_grp$Actual == "CNO" & misMatchDisco_grp$Predicted != "CNO",]$ID

# If any CRP
if ("P02741" %in% rownames(impMatDiscovery_nonFilt)) {
  
  # Get abundance
  crpAbundData <- data.frame(CRP=t(impMatDiscovery_nonFilt["P02741",trainMetaData$Sample_ID]))
  crpAbundData["Sample_ID"] <- rownames(crpAbundData)
  crpAbundData["MisPrediction"] <- "No"
  crpAbundData[which(crpAbundData$Sample_ID %in% falsePos),]["MisPrediction"] <- "False +ve"
  crpAbundData[which(crpAbundData$Sample_ID %in% falseNeg),]["MisPrediction"] <- "False -ve"
  colnames(crpAbundData)[[1]] <- c("CRP")
  crpAbundData <- merge(crpAbundData, metaCrossSectional_child, by="Sample_ID")
  
  condCols2 <- condCols
  names(condCols2) <- gsub("InfOsteo.*", "Inf Osteo", names(condCols2))
  crpAbundData["Condition"] <- gsub("InfOsteo.*", "Inf Osteo", crpAbundData$Condition)
  
  # Add mis-predictions
  crpAbundData <- merge(crpAbundData, 
                        misMatchDisco_grp[,c("ID", "Predicted")],
                        by.x="Sample_ID",
                        by.y="ID")
  
  # Plot
  plt <- ggplot(crpAbundData[!duplicated(crpAbundData) & crpAbundData$Condition == "CNO",],
         aes(x=reorder(Sample_ID,
                       CRP,
                       decreasing=TRUE),
             y=CRP,
             fill=Predicted)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,
               
               color="darkgrey") +
    geom_point(shape=21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=condCols2) +
    # facet_grid(cols=vars(Condition),
    #            space="free_x", scale="free_x") +
    xlab("Samples per Group") + 
    ggtitle("Discovery Data Training Split") +
    ylab("Log2 CRP\nAbundance") +
    theme_classic(base_size=48) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),
          plot.title=element_text(size=72),
          strip.text=element_text(size=28),
          axis.title=element_text(size=72))
  
  # Save
  ggsave(here::here(validDir, "protAbundance",
                    "misPredictions_bydiscoveryData_inCNOSamples.png"),
         plt,
         width=8000, height=3000, units="px")
  
   # Add to list
  newList <- list(plt)
  names(newList) <- c(paste0("misPredict_byCRPAbundance_inDiscoData_", imputMethod))
  plotList <- append(plotList,
                     newList)
  
}
```

#### Shuffle labels

```{r}

# Shuffle data
shuffSplits_bim <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=biModalSplits, 
                                          metaData=trainMetaData,
                                          selectProts=commonProtsCNO,
                                          responseVar="BiModal",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                      floor(sqrt(length(commonProtsCNO))),
                                                       bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                          num.trees=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_biModal$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplits=groupSplits, 
                                          metaData=trainMetaData,
                                          selectProts=commonProtsGrp,
                                          responseVar="Condition",
                                          nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                          mtry=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$mTry,
                                          min.node.size=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                          num.trees=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                          splitrule=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                          max.depth=bestModel_multiGroup$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                          covs2Include=covs2Select)
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- shuffleDiscoverySplits(dataSplit=biModalSplits_grpProts, 
                                                     metaData=trainMetaData,
                                                     selectProts=allCommonProts,
                                                     responseVar="BiModal",
                                                     nReps=nReps_forDecoyShuffle,
                                                     mtry=ifelse(bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry == "default", 
                                                                 floor(sqrt(length(allCommonProts))),
                                                                 bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$mTry),
                                                     min.node.size=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$minNodeSize,
                                                     num.trees=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$nRFTrees,
                                                     splitrule=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$SplitRule,
                                                     max.depth=bestModel_biModal_grpProts$OptimalParams$MaxDepth,
                                                     covs2Include=covs2Select)

# Combine
shuffSplitMetrics_bim <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_bim),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_bim[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_bim[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))
shuffSplitMetrics_grp <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_grp[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- do.call("rbind",
                             lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther),
                                    function(i)
                                    do.call("rbind",
                                            lapply(seq_along(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther[[i]]),
                                                 function(j) { data.frame(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther[[i]][[j]]$Metrics,
                                                                          Split=i,
                                                                          Rep=j) }))))

# Add actual performance
shuffSplitMetrics_bim <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplitMetrics_bim, 
                                        id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))
shuffSplitMetrics_grp <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplitMetrics_grp, 
                                        id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))
shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther <- reshape2::melt(shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther, 
                                             id.vars=c("Split", "Group", "Rep"))

# Fix variables
shuffSplitMetrics <- rbind(cbind(Set="Bi-Modal", 
                                 shuffSplitMetrics_bim),
                           cbind(Set="Multi-Modal", 
                                 shuffSplitMetrics_grp),
                           cbind(Set="Bi-Modal (Whole Panel)", 
                                 shuffSplits_grp_CNOvsOther))

# Tidy names
shuffSplitMetrics["variable"] <- gsub("[.]", " ", shuffSplitMetrics$variable)
```

#### Create artificial data split

```{r}

# Scale
quantTableTrain_scaled <- apply(impMatDiscovery[,trainMetaData$Sample_ID], 2, scale, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE)
quantTableTest_scaled <- apply(impMatDiscovery[,testMetaData$Sample_ID], 2, scale, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE)
rownames(quantTableTrain_scaled) <- rownames(impMatDiscovery)
rownames(quantTableTest_scaled) <- rownames(impMatDiscovery)

# Create to match the data splits above
biModal_testData <- list(list(train=t(as.matrix(quantTableTrain_scaled[commonProtsCNO,
                                                       trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                         test=t(as.matrix(quantTableTest_scaled[commonProtsCNO,
                                                      testMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                         factor_train=setNames(trainMetaData$BiModal,
                                               trainMetaData$Sample_ID),
                         factor_test=setNames(testMetaData$BiModal,
                                               testMetaData$Sample_ID)))
mGroup_testData <- list(list(train=t(as.matrix(quantTableTrain_scaled[commonProtsGrp,
                                                      trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                        test=t(as.matrix(quantTableTest_scaled[commonProtsGrp,
                                                     testMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                        factor_train=setNames(trainMetaData$Condition,
                                              trainMetaData$Sample_ID),
                        factor_test=setNames(testMetaData$Condition,
                                             testMetaData$Sample_ID)))
biModalGrpProts_testData <- list(list(train=t(as.matrix(quantTableTrain_scaled[allCommonProts,
                                                               trainMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                                test=t(as.matrix(quantTableTest_scaled[allCommonProts,
                                                             testMetaData$Sample_ID])),
                                factor_train=setNames(trainMetaData$BiModal,
                                                      trainMetaData$Sample_ID),
                                factor_test=setNames(testMetaData$BiModal,
                                                     testMetaData$Sample_ID)))
```
